script.text: The mid-autumn festival fell on a Tuesday this year,‖
and campus dining hall handed out mooncakes.‖
My roommate wrote 中秋节快乐 on a card for me.
I taped it above my desk.‖
The night stayed warm even after nine.‖

clauses.english: The mid-autumn festival fell on a Tuesday this year,
clauses.reference: 今年的中秋节正好是星期二，

clauses.english: and campus dining hall handed out mooncakes.
clauses.reference: 校园食堂也发了月饼。

clauses.english: I taped it above my desk.
clauses.reference: 我把它贴在了书桌上方。

clauses.english: The night stayed warm even after nine.
clauses.reference: 那晚九点以后依然很暖和。

script.text: Even though we had already tested the lotus paste recipe twice this month and adjusted the sugar amount both times based on notes from last year, we are baking mooncakes for the whole building tonight,‖
and the lotus paste keeps stic
king to the rolling pin.‖
Someone brought extra egg yolks for the centers.‖
Molds finally arrived just in time.‖
Wax paper lined every tray before baking.‖
The first batch came out slightly golden on top instead of the deep brown the recipe photo showed.‖
Everyone wants a mooncake before it even cools.‖

clauses.english: Even though we had already tested the lotus paste recipe twice this month and adjusted the sugar amount both times based on notes from last year, we are baking mooncakes for the whole building tonight,
clauses.reference: 虽然这个月我们已经试做过两次莲蓉馅，还根据去年的笔记两次调整了糖量，今晚我们还是要给整栋楼烤月饼，

clauses.english: and the lotus paste keeps sticking to the rolling pin.
clauses.reference: 莲蓉一直粘在擀面杖上。

clauses.english: Someone brought extra egg yolks for the centers.
clauses.reference: 有人多带了些咸蛋黄放在中间。

clauses.english: Molds finally arrived just in time.
clauses.reference: 模具总算及时到了。

clauses.english: Wax paper lined every tray before baking.
clauses.reference: 烘烤之前每个托盘都铺了油纸。

clauses.english: The first batch came out slightly golden on top instead of the deep brown the recipe photo showed.
clauses.reference: 第一炉出炉时颜色只是略微金黄，不像食谱照片里那么深的棕色。

clauses.english: Everyone wants a mooncake before it even cools.
clauses.reference: 月饼还没凉大家就都想要了。

script.text: The broth simmered six hours on low heat,‖
and the kitchen smelled of star anise.‖

The broth turned out rich.‖
